name: doza-assist
description: Your own Doza Assist projects on this Mac: read transcripts and selects, search a transcript, create selects, build a selects stringout.
long_description: Requires the Doza Assist app for macOS (free trial at https://doza.ai/download.html). Talks to the app running on this Mac over loopback. Only projects you switched on (project page gear menu > AI assistant access) are visible. Media never leaves the Mac; only transcript text and selects travel, and nothing here can delete or edit your clips. Doza Assist must be open.

app_path.title: Doza Assist app
app_path.description: Where Doza Assist.app is installed. Leave the default unless you run a copy from another folder.

tools.name: list_my_projects
tools.description: List the projects opened to AI assistants
